status: design discussion complete; not an executable experiment contract

method_priority.first: one common low-dimensional signed normalized 14-day residual model from all input-eligible observed-complete windows
method_priority.objective: squared error targeting conditional mean observed sales; not latent demand

evaluation.name: already-read 2014 chronological replay diagnosis
evaluation.parameter_update: quarter start only, then fixed inside quarter
evaluation.split_unit: all FIT stores at an origin together
evaluation.outer_feedback: no discretionary changes; earlier labels may enter later fixed refit rule only

guards.guarantee: empirical eligibility only; not future or each-window guarantee
guards.unsupported_preissue_policy: baseline, reason saved; never use future missingness

not_ready_until_fixed_before_any_fit: exact features and eligibility without target lookahead
positive quantity conversion and daily allocation
fixed regularization strength and normalization of objective
past-only calibration rule and support fallback
support and influence audit definitions, without optimizing thresholds on current two points
time-varying state/schema/source and label-isolation fixture checks
next_permitted_unit: metadata and input/label isolation fixture design only; no automatic fit or score
independent_future_validation: requires separate unused-scope authorization and fully frozen pre-2015 model/policy; current plan grants neither
campaign_stop: one predeclared diagnostic only if subsequently contracted; no rescue, candidate additions or automatic 2015 confirmation
